ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixel coverage concentrated along the lower trailing margin and lateral tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Localized high-intensity pixel clusters forming a mottled band along the lower central region; distinct white focal points at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered stippling across the central-lower ventral surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Central V-shaped notch with an approximate interior angle of 85 degrees; vertical depth relative to lobe height is approximately 1/4.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge; amplitude varies from 2-10 pixels; significant indentation approximately 1/3 from the right tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing edge transitioning to sharp, upward-curving acute angles at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast, high-relief white clusters indicative of barnacle colonies on the extreme lateral tips of both lobes; secondary cluster on the top-left margin.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of faint, roughly parallel diagonal linear disruptions in the dark pigmentation on the left lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive barnacle colonization at the lateral tips creating significant textural and color contrast against the dark fluke surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white stippling pattern concentrated near the central insertion point of the fluke.
